notes: Uses the Saturdays booked two years ahead (rule 3).

responses.value: Prices turn on demand by day, couples' budgets, competitor venues' prices, and our cost per event. I'd start with inquiries turned away and booking lead time by day of the week for two years, since Saturdays are oversold while Fridays and Sundays have room.
Competitor prices: with Saturdays booked two years ahead, we can likely charge more, but only up to what rival venues ask.
